commands.name: event_create
commands.description: Makes a new event, timed or all-day.

args.name: title
args.meaning: The event's title; one non-empty line.

args.name: start
args.meaning: Start as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" local time, or "YYYY-MM-DD" with all_day=True.

args.name: end
args.meaning: End as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" local time, or the last day as "YYYY-MM-DD" with all_day=True.

args.name: location
args.meaning: Where it happens.

args.name: calendar
args.meaning: Local calendar to put it in, by exact name; None means the first local calendar.

args.name: all_day
args.meaning: True for an all-day event.

args.name: notes
args.meaning: Notes for the event.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

example_requests: Add a dentist appointment on 18 November from 3:15 to 4 pm in Room 4
Put a team offsite on my Work calendar for 30 November and 1 December
Block out Friday afternoon for the car service
Add Mum's birthday as an all-day event on 5 December
commands.precondition: If calendar is given, exactly one local calendar has that name; if not, at least one local calendar exists. For background mode, it has Automation permission for Calendar.
commands.postcondition: A new event exists with these values. Other events with the same title are left alone.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: title is not one non-empty line, a date is not in the right format, or end is not after start, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui": typing into Calendar's date fields through System Events was not reliable

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no local calendar has that exact name

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one local calendar has that name; nothing is changed

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: Calendar's scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

commands.name: event_list
commands.description: Lists the events that start between two days, both included, earliest first, counting only the first occurrence of a repeating event.

args.name: from_date
args.meaning: First day, "YYYY-MM-DD".

args.name: to_date
args.meaning: Last day, "YYYY-MM-DD".

args.name: limit
args.meaning: The most events to return.

args.name: fields
args.meaning: Keys to return, as a comma-separated string or a list; None means the default set.

args.name: calendar
args.meaning: Local calendar to list, by exact name; None means every local calendar.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

example_requests: What's on my calendar on 18 November?
Show me everything next week
List my Work calendar for this month
commands.precondition: If calendar is given, exactly one local calendar has that name. For background mode, it has Automation permission for Calendar.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: a date is not YYYY-MM-DD, fields names an unknown key and there are results, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui": this command only reads, and has no verified ui mode

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no local calendar has that exact name

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one local calendar has that name; nothing is changed

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: Calendar's scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

args.name: from_date
args.meaning: First day, "YYYY-MM-DD".

args.name: to_date
args.meaning: Last day, "YYYY-MM-DD".

args.name: fields
args.meaning: Keys to return, as a comma-separated string or a list; None means the default set.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

example_requests: When is my dentist appointment this month?
Find anything in Room 4 next week
Do I have a meeting about the budget in November?
commands.precondition: For background mode, it has Automation permission for Calendar.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: a date is not YYYY-MM-DD, fields names an unknown key and there are results, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui": this command only reads, and has no verified ui mode

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: Calendar's scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

commands.name: event_get
commands.description: Gets the event with an exact title that starts on a given day.

args.name: match
args.meaning: The event's exact title.

args.name: date
args.meaning: The day it starts, "YYYY-MM-DD".

args.name: fields
args.meaning: Keys to return, as a comma-separated string or a list; None means the default set.

args.name: calendar
args.meaning: Local calendar to look in, by exact name, when the same title exists twice that day.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

example_requests: What time is the Dentist on 18 November?
Where is the Team offsite on 30 November?
Show me the details of Standup on Wednesday
commands.precondition: Exactly one event with that title starts that day, within calendar if given. For background mode, it has Automation permission for Calendar.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: a date is not YYYY-MM-DD, fields names an unknown key, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui": this command only reads, and has no verified ui mode

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no event with that exact title starts that day, within calendar if given, or calendar is given and no local calendar has that name

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one event matches; nothing is changed

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: Calendar's scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

commands.name: event_update
commands.description: Changes the given values of an event and leaves the rest as they are.

args.name: match
args.meaning: The event's exact title now.

args.name: date
args.meaning: The day it starts now, "YYYY-MM-DD".

args.name: title
args.meaning: New title; one non-empty line.

args.name: start
args.meaning: New start, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM", or "YYYY-MM-DD" for an all-day event; give end too to move the event.

args.name: end
args.meaning: New end, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM", or the last day as "YYYY-MM-DD" for an all-day event.

args.name: location
args.meaning: New location.

args.name: notes
args.meaning: New notes.

args.name: all_day
args.meaning: True or False to change whether it is all-day; None leaves it.

args.name: calendar
args.meaning: Local calendar to look in, by exact name, when the same title exists twice that day. It does not move the event.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

example_requests: Move my dentist appointment on the 18th to the 20th at the same time
Change the Standup on Wednesday to Room 5
Rename the Team offsite on 30 November to Team retreat
Add a note to Friday's Gym saying bring a towel
commands.precondition: Exactly one event with that title starts that day, within calendar if given. For background mode, it has Automation permission for Calendar.
commands.postcondition: The event holds the new values, and values not given are unchanged.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: title is not one non-empty line, a date is not YYYY-MM-DD, a date is not in the right format, or end is not after start, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui": typing into Calendar's date fields through System Events was not reliable

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no event with that exact title starts that day, within calendar if given, or calendar is given and no local calendar has that name

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one event matches; nothing is changed

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: Calendar's scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

commands.name: event_delete
commands.description: Deletes the event with an exact title that starts on a given day.

args.name: match
args.meaning: The event's exact title.

args.name: date
args.meaning: The day it starts, "YYYY-MM-DD".

args.name: calendar
args.meaning: Local calendar to look in, by exact name, when the same title exists twice that day.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

example_requests: Delete the Dentist on 18 November
Cancel my Gym session on Friday
Remove the Hold: focus event on the 18th from my Work calendar
commands.precondition: Exactly one event with that title starts that day, within calendar if given. For ui mode, the program running Python has Accessibility and Automation permission for System Events and Calendar. For background mode, it has Automation permission for Calendar.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: a date is not YYYY-MM-DD, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no event with that exact title starts that day, within calendar if given, or calendar is given and no local calendar has that name

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one event matches; nothing is changed

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: Calendar shows a dialog with typed text or with no Cancel button, or a Quick Event with typed text; nothing is changed

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a screen element never appeared in time, Calendar's scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

commands.name: calendar_create
commands.description: Makes a new local calendar in On My Mac.

args.name: name
args.meaning: The calendar's name; one non-empty line.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

example_requests: Make a new calendar called Running club
Create a Family calendar
I need a separate calendar for Work
commands.precondition: No local calendar has that name. For ui mode, the program running Python has Accessibility and Automation permission for System Events and Calendar. For background mode, it has Automation permission for Calendar.
commands.postcondition: A local calendar with that name exists.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: name is not one non-empty line, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.when: a local calendar has that name

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: Calendar shows a dialog with typed text or with no Cancel button, or a Quick Event with typed text, in which case nothing is changed; or another app is in front when the call goes to type

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a screen element never appeared in time, Calendar's scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time
